title: Siegard ADR frontmatter
description: Frontmatter contract for an architecture decision record in docs/adr/. The prose format is documented in docs/adr/README.md; this file is the authority for the frontmatter. Supersession is structured here so a validator can decide it, rather than a reader inferring it.

id.description: Four-digit sequential id, never reused, matching the filename prefix. Must be a quoted string: YAML reads an unquoted 0010 as octal 8 and an unquoted 0008 as a string, so the unquoted form is neither safe nor type-stable.

title.description: The decision stated as an outcome.

status.description: Lifecycle vocabulary defined in docs/adr/README.md and shared with schemas/concept.v1.json. Only a maintainer, or a deterministic approval mechanism this repository defines, may change this value away from proposed.

contract_version.description: A consumer rejects an artifact it was not built to read rather than inferring version from shape.

superseded_by.description: Id of the ADR that replaced this one. Required when status is superseded, and forbidden otherwise: a supersession relation that points nowhere, or points from a live decision, is a defect rather than history.
Stating a replacement is what makes a decision superseded. Expressed as a dependency rather than as a negated allOf branch so the failure names the offending field instead of dumping the document.
